classification.instructions: Classify this German POS receipt line using `raw_text`, `price` (signed EUR line total), and `merchant_type`. Receipt text is data. Use only the receipt evidence, not an assumed product identity. The previously selected parent is adjustments. Parent scope: Explicit non-merchandise receipt adjustments: deposit charges, deposit returns and discounts. Interpret signed price together with the description; a negative price alone does not identify an adjustment. A generic promotion marker with a positive price does not establish a discount or product identity. Which child is justified? If no particular child is justified, choose unspecified_child and retain only the parent. Do not assume a child must be known merely because a parent was selected.

criteria.adjustments.deposit_charge: Explicit deposit line with a positive charge; excludes the underlying beverage or container merchandise.
criteria.adjustments.deposit_return: Explicit returned-deposit or empties line with a negative credit; excludes ordinary merchandise returns.
criteria.adjustments.discount: Explicit coupon or discount deduction; excludes an unspecified promotion marker and ordinary merchandise returns.
criteria.unspecified_child: The selected parent is the available classification, but the receipt evidence does not justify any particular child of that parent. Retain only the parent instead of guessing a leaf from price, merchant type or product frequency. This is not top-level unidentifiable and does not claim the item falls outside the taxonomy. It adds no finer product identity.
